title: Version 1.32.0
body:
Version 1.32.0

July 31st, 2023

Added:

  • Added harvestable Kelp to the water

Changes:

  • Moved underwater resource regions closer to the beach
  • Tutorial storyline has been updated to be more interactive, and less reading
  • Rusty Saw has been buffed

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed regeneration from water damage
  • Healing coil now works in the water

Version 1.32.1

July 31st, 2023

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed Mobile Driving

Version 1.32.2

July 31st, 2023

Changed:

  • Increased weight of Sellner Explorer to help with flinging
  • Increased price of all crate variations
  • Decreased mobile hotbar UI size
  • Nerfed price of Kelp due to it's availability
